The lesions are small, raised dots (uredinia/pustules) on the underside, matching both the symptom description and the Soybean_rust reference (top-right panel close-up).

Key differentiators:
- Lesions are on the **lower leaf surface** (not upper)
- Small, scattered individual pustules — not angular bacterial blight lesions, not large blotches
- Tan/brown coloration without distinctive halos or angular margins
- Pattern matches soybean rust pustule distribution exactly
